description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) has been placed on Injured Reserve.
items.impact: Robinson has missed the last several games with a hamstring injury, and apparently hasn't made enough progress for the team to keep him off of IR. He will miss at least the next four games. The Falcons will need to elevate someone to back up Bijan Robinson.
items.title: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) placed on Injured Reserve

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Pat Bryant (ankle) has been activated from injured reserve ahead of Denver's game against the Panthers on Sunday.
items.impact: Bryant is still officially questionable, but his activation indicates that he will play on Sunday. He'll be a tough start in his first game back, but could have some flex appeal in later weeks.
items.title: Pat Bryant (ankle) activated off of IR

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Kendre Miller has been released by the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Miller had his moments, but could never string anything together during his injury-riddled career in New Orleans. He didn't seem to endear himself to coaching staff's either, as multiple different coaches passed over him for the starting job unless they had no other option. He will look to find a new home elsewhere.
items.title: Kendre Miller released by the Saints

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: The Baltimore Ravens D/ST was run over by the Jaguars on Thursday, allowing 33 points in the 23-point loss. They did manage a fumble recovery, but that was the only real counting stat they managed.
items.impact: It was a rough showing by the Ravens' unit, but they weren't helped by the offense, which often gave the Jaguars short fields to work with, putting more pressure on the defense. They will look to get things back on track against the Chargers.
items.title: Baltimore Ravens D/ST struggle against Jacksonville

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jake Moody hit his only field goal and PAT attempts in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to Jacksonville on Thursday,
items.impact: Moody filled in well for the injured Tyler Loop, but didn't get much of a chance to put points on the board. Hopefully things will improve for the Ravens in the coming weeks.
items.title: Jake Moody hits four kicking points in loss

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Justice Hill ran nine times for 85 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday. He also caught three passes for seven yards.
items.impact: Hill managed the one explosive play by the Ravens all night, breaking away for a long touchdown late in the game. He could be an interesting flex option moving forward as the Ravens change of pace back.
items.title: Justice Hill breaks away for long TD in loss

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane was held without a catch in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
items.impact: Lane has only one catch in the last two games, but it's hard to take away much from Thursday's game, where the Ravens only had 10 completions, and their leading receiver had only 19 yards. So don't lose hope on Lane just yet.
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane held without a catch in loss

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Rashod Bateman caught one of two targets for six yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
items.impact: Bateman has two catches in as many weeks, and he's fallen out of relevance for fantasy. Leave him on waivers until he shows some sort of value.
items.title: Rashod Bateman hauls in short pass in loss

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) is off of the injury report for Week 9 for the San Francisco 49ers according to Nick Wagoner.
items.impact: McCaffrey is good to go once again while fighting through a lingering hamstring issue for head coach Kyle Shanahan, lining up the dynamic running back for another sizeable workload against a generous Raiders defense Sunday.
items.title: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) off injury report for Week 9

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Mark Andrews caught both of his targets for 19 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
items.impact: Andrews led the Ravens in receiving yards in the blowout loss, not that it meant much for fantasy. He's been tough to trust at any point this season and is safe to leave on the waiver wire. However, if you want to hold on and see what he might do with Jacoby Brissett at QB, there's merit to that.
items.title: Mark Andrews snags two passes in loss

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Zay Flowers caught three of six targets for 6 yards and ran three times for 17 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
items.impact: Flowers had three more catches than he had on Sunday, but it didn't amount to much. Jacoby Brissett should bring back some life to the fantasy value of Flowers once he takes the reins of the offense, and thankfully that should come next week.
items.title: Zay Flowers manages 23 yards in loss to Jags

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Joe Fagnano completed 10 of 18 passes for 60 yards with two interceptions in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars. He also ran three times for 13 yards.
items.impact: Fagnano's first NFL start actually got off decently well; he showed confidence and was rushing to get first downs. However, that eroded quickly as the Jaguars figured things out, and he had no answers. The Ravens' finalized their trade for Jacoby Brissett on Friday, so this will likely be Fagnano's only start unless Brissett also suffers an injury.
items.title: Joe Fagnano struggles in spot start on TNF

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Derrick Henry ran 17 times for 57 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday.
items.impact: Henry didn't have a touchdown or a reception to save his lackluster rushing totals, as the Jaguars bottled him up all night. The Ravens have now scored no more than 13 points in each of the last four games, and Henry's fantasy points are evidence of that. He at least gets a favorable matchup against the Chargers next time out.
items.title: Derrick Henry struggles in loss to Jaguars

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Cam Little hit all four of his field goal attempts and all three PATs in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: Little now has totals of 10, 7, 7, 6, and 15 kicking points in his last five games. He's been a great play for fantasy and one of the better kickers so far in 2026.
items.title: Cam Little racks up 15 kicking points in win

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: The Jacksonville Jaguars D/ST had a sack, a fumble recovery and two interceptions in the Jags' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday.
items.impact: The Jags' defense dominated in this game, granted it didn't hurt that they were facing a third-string quarterback making his first NFL start on a short week. They held the Ravens to a measly 55 passing yards (counting sacks), and routinely messed up the Baltimore run game. They face off next against Tennessee.
items.title: Jacksonville Jaguars handle Ravens in TNF win

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Nate Boerkircher caught two of three targets for 61 yards in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday.
items.impact: Boerkircher now has either 61 yards or a touchdown in his last three games on just two targets a game. It's an interesting development for the likes of Brenton Strange, who saw his workload decrease on Thursday night. However, that could just be circumstantial and not prescriptive.
items.title: Nate Boerkircher goes for 61 yards in win

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Brenton Strange caught both of his targets for 22 yards in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: It was a bit of a letdown after Strange had been successful in the last few weeks as a streaming tight end play. Nate Boerkircher has started to get more involved in recent weeks, and that could be limiting Strange's upside.
items.title: Brenton Strange goes for 22 yards in win

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Brian Thomas Jr. was not targeted in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens.
items.impact: Thomas caught a touchdown on Sunday, and was held without a target on Thursday. The "downfield threat," as the Jaguars coaching staff has called him, has only 117 yards all season and can be safely dropped, unless you want to hold and hope he gets traded before the deadline.
items.title: Brian Thomas Jr. held without a target in win

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers caught four of six passes for 65 yards in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday.
items.impact: Meyers led the team in receptions and yards, while coming in second in targets. It was the veteran's second-best yardage total of the season, and he now has 65 yards or more in two of his last three games.
items.title: Jakobi Meyers snags four passes in win

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Chris Rodriguez Jr. ran 10 times fo 19 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens. He also caught both of his targets for 13 yards.
items.impact: Rodriguez matched Bhayshul Tuten for touches, but crucially got the receiving work, giving him the edge in half- and full-PPR formats. He's heavily touchdown-dependent, but the good news is he could see another chance to score against the Titans next week if the Jags can build up a big lead.
items.title: Chris Rodriguez Jr. hammers in touchdown in win over Ravens

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Parker Washington caught two of seven targets for 61 yards and a score in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday.
items.impact: Almost all of Washington's fantasy points came on a long 50-yard catch-and-run touchdown in the first half. He failed to bring in anything else after that and suffered some drops as well. It wasn't the greatest game for the talented WR, but it certainly could have been much worse.
items.title: Parker Washington snags touchdown in win over Ravens

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten ran 12 times for 29 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens on Thursday.
items.impact: Tuten struggled to get much going in this game, with his longest run being six yards. The Ravens' defense did a good job keeping things in front of them and not allowing many explosive plays by the Jags, and Tuten suffered for it. He will look to have a better time out against the Titans next week.
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten struggles in rainy game

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Trevor Lawrence completed 16 of 26 passes for 242 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens. He also ran once for -1 yard.
items.impact: Lawrence didn't have to do much to get his team the win in this game, much like Sunday when he faced the Colts. His one touchdown came on a breakaway play by Parker Washington, who was quiet aside from that play. Lawrence gets another easy matchup next week against the Titans. They will be well rested, however, as Tennessee is on a bye, but the Jaguars have a mini-bye themselves thanks to the Thursday game.
items.title: Trevor Lawrence throws for 242 yards in rainy TNF

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Mike Evans (achilles) has been ruled out for Week 9 for the San Francisco 49ers according to Nick Wagoner.
items.impact: Evans will not suit up after struggling to reach the practice field this week, lining up Demarcus Robinson (ankle) and Brandin Cooks to lead a shorthanded wideout group against the Raiders for head coach Kyle Shanahan Sunday.
items.title: Mike Evans (achilles) ruled out for Week 9

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) has been ruled out for Week 9 for the San Francisco 49ers according to Nick Wagoner.
items.impact: Samuel Sr. will sit out once again for head coach Kyle Shanahan with an eye towards returning in Week 10, with Brandin Cooks and Demarcus Robinson (ankle) in line to lead a banged-up wideout group against the Raiders Sunday.
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) ruled out for Week 9
